newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ballarat meets to decide on bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ballarat meets to decide on bid.

text.p: Pub operator Ballarat Brewing Co Ltd said its board will meet later on Wednesday to decide whether to accept Foster's Brewing Group Ltd's revised A$2.56 per share takeover bid.

"The board are meeting today to consider the material change in circumstances," Ballarat General Manager Noel Phillips told Reuters. "Once that meeting concludes we expect to release a statement around 2.30-3.00 p.m. (0330-0400 GMT)," he said.

Earlier on Wednesday, corporate raider Guinness Peat Group Ltd, which still has a takeover bid for Ballarat open at A$2.50 per share, said it would accept Foster's bid for its 17.90 percent stake in Ballarat.

Foster's already has a 42.49 percent stake in Ballarat, giving it more than 50 percent of the issued shares. Foster's increased its November bid of A$2.50 per share to A$2.56 per share earlier this week, valuing Ballarat at A$69.36 million.
Ballarat has said shareholders should reject the A$2.50 bids by Foster's and GPG because they were below the fair value range assessed by Grant Samuel & Associates of A$2.56 to A$2.93 a share.
Ballarat shares were down three cents at A$2.62 at 11.20 a.m. (0020 GMT).
